scoring_justification: Checker recomputes I via numerical integration of the known geometry factor F(x) and validates scaling relations by structural proportionality audit.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Standard handbook formula for three-point bend specimen with S/W=4 (Tada, Paris, Irwin), used by the paper to compute I.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Formula is the established geometry factor that reproduces the paper’s I curves.

outputs.description: Numerical values of the integral I(x0,n) obtained by numerical integration with the known three‑point bend geometry factor.
Verification of the scaling relations: for large cracks T_f ∝ W, for small cracks T_f ∝ a0.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are nondimensional where specified. The geometry factor F(x) for a three‑point bend specimen with span S=4W is a publicly available standard expression.

audit_config.large_crack_proportionality: T_f/W constant across varying W at fixed K_Ii and a0
audit_config.small_crack_proportionality: T_f/a0 constant across varying a0 at fixed K_Ii and W
